name: research_real_pipeline_acceptance
logic_name: Run bounded real-process metrics with capability-authorized workspace mutations, durable evidence, keep/revert, and crash recovery

test_list.description: A deliberately mismatched actual tool target is checked against an exact-path attenuated capability and is rejected before its filesystem write.

Use actual child metric processes and a concrete temporary Git repository; check 20 decisions, exact final file, capability authorizations, receipts, and ledger reopen. The local process fixture does not prove sandbox isolation.

A helper process exits after persisting an in-flight checkpoint and changing a tracked file; a fresh parent process reopens the store and VCS adapter and verifies exact baseline recovery before continuing.
The checkpoint-store ledger test reopens valid linked evidence and rejects malformed pointers or chain nodes.

inputs.name: program
inputs.description: Immutable metric command, scopes, and total resource budget.

inputs.name: candidate
inputs.description: Candidate content written only after signed capability authorization.

output_description: A real local-process acceptance result with persisted metric, tool, mutation, and recovery evidence links.
